members.name: Dark Pact
members.note: -2 HP/tick, +2 mana/tick. P99 level 8.

members.name: Allure of Death
members.note: -5 HP/tick, +4 mana/tick. P99 level 20.

members.name: Call of Bones
members.note: -10 HP/tick, +8 mana/tick, adds bleached-skeleton illusion + ultravision. P99 level 34.

members.name: Lich
members.note: -22 HP/tick, +20 mana/tick, bloody-skeleton illusion. P99 level 49.

members.name: Arch Lich
members.note: -20 HP/tick, +20 mana/tick, spectre illusion + see invis. Velious drop. Sidegrade to Demi Lich: same mana, far cheaper HP.

members.name: Demi Lich
members.note: -48 HP/tick, +31 mana/tick. Highest mana return, highest HP cost.

replacement.note: Strictly ascending through Lich, then splits. Arch Lich (20 mana / -20 HP) and Demi Lich (31 mana / -48 HP) are a deliberate choice, not an upgrade: Arch Lich is the sustainable/low-HP-pool option, Demi Lich the max-throughput option. Lower ranks stay useful when HP regen cannot cover the drain (classic 'lich you can afford' rule), so no rank is ever obsolete in practice.

conflicts.detail: All six occupy the single 'Mana Regeneration (Lich)' line; only one can be up. Casting a different rank replaces the active one.

Call of Bones / Lich / Arch Lich / Demi Lich carry an illusion component, so they collide with any other illusion (Enchanter illusions, Form of the X, gnomework illusions) the way illusions normally do.
conflicts.source: Legends spell data (Illusion: 60 / Illusion: 85 slots) + https://wiki.project1999.com/Buff_Lines (illusions tracked separately)

stacksWith.detail: Clarity / Clarity II / Boon of the Clear Mind / Gift of Pure Thought / Breeze - separate slot, fully additive.

stacksWith.line: Mana Regeneration (Cantata / Chorus / Gift / Protection of the Glades)
stacksWith.detail: Bard Cantata of Replenishment, Cassindra's Chorus of Clarity, Enchanter Gift of Brilliance, Druid Protection of the Glades all stack with Lich.
Manaskin's +1 mana/tick is a different slot and stacks with the Lich line (P99 explicitly tables Necromancer +67 mana regen with Demi Lich + Manaskin + everything else).

The HP drain is a separate effect slot, not part of any HP-regen buff line. It does not block, and is not blocked by, Regeneration/Chloroplast/Regrowth, Hymn of Restoration, worn regen or Iksar innate regen - the values simply sum arithmetically. This is the classic 'regen offsets lich' interaction and is why the P99 Necromancer page tables Iksar-vs-non-Iksar HP regen under Lich.

stacking.notes: PRIORITY FINDING: the Lich line's HP drain and the game's HP-regeneration buff lines are independent - they net out numerically rather than overwriting each other. P99's Buff_Lines page lists Necromancer max HP regen (+129) and the Lich mana slot separately, and gives a '(Necromancer w/ Lich)' mana row of +67 that includes Demi Lich's +31 alongside every other mana-regen line. The drain is applied every tick regardless of current HP and will kill an unbuffed necro at low HP (hence Harmshield/Quivering Veil and lifetap discipline).

members.name: Clinging Darkness
members.note: 5/tick, -24% to -30% movement.

members.name: Engulfing Darkness
members.note: 11/tick, -40%. P99 level 12.

members.name: Dooming Darkness
members.note: 20/tick, -49% to -60%. P99 level 29.

members.name: Cascading Darkness
members.note: 72/tick, -60%. P99 level 49.

members.name: Devouring Darkness
members.note: 107/tick, -69% to -70%. Fewer ticks than Cascading (13 vs 16), so lower total damage - cast for the snare, not the DPM.

replacement.note: Snare magnitude and damage ascend, but Cascading Darkness (3.84 DPM, 16 ticks, 1152 total) beats Devouring Darkness (3.48 DPM, 13 ticks) on efficiency, so Cascading stays in the book at 59. Lower ranks remain the cheap fear-kite snare.

conflicts.detail: Same-line DoTs never stack with each other; a higher rank overwrites a lower, and a lower will not land over a higher.
Shadow Knights get Clinging / Engulfing / Dooming / Cascading Darkness - same line, so a necro and an SK cannot both have a Darkness DoT on the same mob in the classic/Velious ruleset.
Scythe of the Shadowed Soul's click (75/tick, 16 ticks, snare) is explicitly on the Darkness DoT line and will not stack with any Darkness spell.

stacksWith.detail: Disease, Fire, Poison, Life Drain, Muscle and Splurt all stack alongside a Darkness DoT.
Different spell lines from any class stack (shaman poison/disease, druid fire/poison, wizard, enchanter).

stacking.notes: The snare component follows the same rule as any other movement debuff - a stronger snare from another class (Ranger/Druid Ensnare, Snare) is a different line and can overwrite the movement effect independently of the DoT.

members.name: Disease Cloud
members.note: 5 initial + 1/tick for 30-60 ticks. Classic pull/aggro tool.

members.name: Infectious Cloud
members.note: Targeted AE version, 20 initial + 5/tick, 21 ticks. P99 level 16.

members.name: Scourge
members.note: 40 initial + 24/tick, 21 ticks. P99 level 39.

members.name: Plague
members.note: 60 initial + 55/tick, 22 ticks. 4.23 DPM.

replacement.note: Damage ascends strictly, but Disease Cloud is never retired (10 mana, 30-60 tick duration, best pull/aggro-tag tool in the game) and Infectious Cloud is the only AE member. All four have a direct-damage component that can break root.

conflicts.detail: Same line - Scourge overwrites Infectious Cloud, Plague overwrites Scourge, and an inferior member will not land over a superior one.
Shadow Knights share Disease Cloud, so the line collides across the two classes at the low end.

stacksWith.line: Muscle (Heart Flutter / Asystole / Cessation of Cor)
stacksWith.detail: Also disease-based but a SEPARATE line - a necro can run Plague and Cessation of Cor on the same mob simultaneously. Damage type does not determine the line; the spell line does.
Darkness, Fire, Poison, Life Drain, Splurt all stack alongside.
Different lines (e.g. shaman Affliction/Sicken line), so they stack.

stacking.notes: Long durations mean the tabled DPM is deceptively high - the P99 line table flags that these usually get clipped.

members.name: Heat Blood
members.note: 17/tick. P99 level 12.

members.name: Boil Blood
members.note: 24/tick, 16-21 ticks. P99 level 29.

members.name: Ignite Blood
members.note: 56/tick, 21 ticks, 4.7 DPM. P99 level 49.

members.name: Pyrocruor
members.note: 111/tick, 19 ticks, 5.27 DPM - the necro's most efficient non-Splurt DoT.

replacement.note: Clean ascending chain in damage, DPM and duration. All members carry a -100 fire resist modifier. Only reason to keep a lower rank is mana budget at low level.

conflicts.detail: Same line. The Sept 2002 patch note that allowed same-spell stacking across casters explicitly kept inferior members blocked: 'Heat Blood, being an inferior spell, will still not stack' with Boil Blood.
Shadow Knights get Heat Blood and Boil Blood - the line is shared.

stacksWith.detail: Fire DoT + Splurt + Disease is the classic long-fight stack.
Different lines, so they stack (e.g. druid Immolate line, wizard fire DoTs).

lines.name: Poison DoT (Poison Bolt / Venom of the Snake line)

members.name: Venom of the Snake

members.name: Chilling Embrace

members.name: Envenomed Bolt
members.note: Big DD component + 146/tick (Legends lists 351/tick), 8 ticks. P99/Kunark level 51.

conflicts.detail: Same line - members overwrite/block each other, including Chilling Embrace vs Venom of the Snake.

stacksWith.detail: Poison + Fire + Disease + Darkness + Splurt is the standard full stack.
Tainted Breath / Envenomed Breath line is a different line and stacks.

stacking.notes: Legends' Envenomed Bolt shows 351/tick vs the classic 146/tick - a magnitude discrepancy, flagged rather than averaged.

members.name: Auspice
members.note: 30/tick, 'Return 100% of damage as HP'. Live (Legacy of Ykesha) quest spell, absent from P99. Player reports on Allakhazam say it does not stack with Bond of Death, i.e. it is on this line.

members.name: Bond of Death
members.note: 80/tick for 9 ticks.

members.name: Vexing Mordinia
members.note: 122/tick (P99 tables 111/tick and flags the discrepancy), 10 ticks damage / 9 ticks healing - a known bug/asymmetry.

replacement.note: Ascending in damage and healing throughput. Auspice sits between Vampiric Curse and Bond of Death on level but is a group-flavoured variant on live; treat as same-line. These are the mana-efficient heal: better HP-per-mana than the instant lifetaps, but delivered over 9-10 ticks.

conflicts.detail: Same line - Auspice explicitly reported as not stacking with Bond of Death.
Shadow Knights get Vampiric Curse, so the line is shared at that rank.

stacksWith.detail: Runs alongside Fire/Poison/Disease/Darkness/Splurt.
Instant lifetaps are direct-damage spells, not DoTs - they stack freely with an active Life Drain DoT.

stacking.notes: All members carry a -200 magic resist modifier, making this the hardest-to-resist necro DoT line.

members.name: Heart Flutter
members.note: 12/tick, -STR/-AC. P99 level 16.

members.name: Asystole
members.note: 69/tick, -37 to -40 STR, -16 to -18 AC. P99 level 44.

members.name: Cessation of Cor
members.note: 100/tick for 11 ticks, -50 STR, -19 to -21 AC. 4.4 DPM, no DD component - the premier root-rot DoT.

replacement.note: Strict upgrade in damage and debuff magnitude. No member has a direct-damage component, so the whole line is root-safe.

conflicts.detail: Same line.
Shadow Knights share Heart Flutter and Asystole.

The -STR component may collide with other strength debuffs (necro Siphon Strength / Enfeeblement line, shaman Cripple/Weaken line) even though the DoT damage is on its own line. Unverified against a slot table - treat as open.

stacksWith.detail: PRIORITY: the Muscle line is disease-based but is a DIFFERENT line from the Disease DoT line, so Plague and Cessation of Cor stack on the same target. Damage type does not define the stacking line.
Fire, Poison, Darkness, Life Drain, Splurt.

members.name: Splurt
members.note: 11 damage on tick 1, +12 per tick for 17 ticks to a final 203. 1819 total for 240 mana = 7.58 DPM, the highest-DPM DoT in classic EQ. -100 MR.

replacement.note: Single-member line; nothing replaces it in the classic/Kunark set.

stacksWith.detail: Splurt is its own line and is the anchor of the full-stack long-fight rotation (Splurt + Pyrocruor + Plague + Cessation of Cor + a Darkness snare).

stacking.notes: Only pays off if it runs its full 17 ticks - clipping it destroys the DPM advantage.

members.note: 11/tick, -20% incoming healing, 1 min.

stacking.notes: No spell named 'Cancelling of Life', 'Negation of Life' or 'Cessation of Life' exists in the Allakhazam Necromancer list (searched 'of Life', type=nec, level 1 and higher: only Spook the Dead, Panic the Dead and the level-77 Anathema of Life ranks return). The 'Decrease Incoming Healing' effect is also a modern SPA. High confidence this is a Legends-custom line.

members.name: Lifespike
members.note: 7-12. P99 level 4.

members.name: Lifebite
members.note: 42/42, 1.75 s cast, 35 mana, autogranted. ADDED BY THE GAME PATCH OF 2026-08-18 (JOS-439) - wiki pageid 60016, created 2026-08-18T15:42Z, so no earlier scrape could have seen it. It has no P99 or live counterpart: Legends invented this rung. Owner log evidence at research time: 288 begins-casting, 246 damage lines, 251 heals, 9 resists, 10 interrupts, 4 fizzles.

members.name: Deflux
members.note: 310-330. LOWER damage than Drain Soul but a 3.0 s cast vs 6.1 s - the emergency fast tap. Sidegrade, not upgrade.

members.name: Gangrenous Touch of Zum`uul
members.note: 720, disease-based (-150 disease resist) rather than magic. Sidegrade to Touch of Night for magic-resistant mobs.

members.name: Trucidation
members.note: 1100, 15-minute recast, consumes an Essence Emerald. Emergency-only.

replacement.note: Strictly ascending through Drain Soul, then branches: Deflux trades damage for cast speed, Gangrenous Touch trades resist type, Trucidation is a reagent-gated long-recast panic button. All four top-end taps stay in the book simultaneously.

stacksWith.detail: Instant direct-damage-plus-heal spells with no duration - no buff slot, no stacking interaction. They coexist with any DoT, including the Life Drain DoT line.

stacking.notes: All magic-based members carry -200 MR. Shadow Knights share the early ranks (Lifetap, Lifespike, Lifedraw, Siphon Life, Spirit Tap, Drain Spirit, Drain Soul) but since these are instants there is no cross-class stacking issue.

members.name: Banish Undead
members.note: 585. P99 level 49.

replacement.note: Strictly ascending damage and DPM through Exile Undead. Banishment of Shadows is a different kind of spell (instant destroy, reagent + long recast) appended to the top of the line.

stacking.notes: Instant nukes - no stacking interactions.

missingOnLegends: Torbas' Venom Blast (NEC 54 on live) - the next rank is absent from the Legends set.

stacking.notes: Instant nukes.

members.name: Ignite Bones
members.note: 494-500 fire + applies a skeleton illusion to the target. P99 level 44.

members.name: Incinerate Bones
members.note: Same damage as Ignite Bones, WITHOUT the illusion side effect. Chardok-revamp drop; the 'clean' version.

members.name: Conglaciation of Bone
members.note: 500 cold, no illusion. The Chardok-revamp 'clean' twin of Chill Bones.

replacement.note: Two parallel pairs, not one chain: Ignite Bones -> Chill Bones (illusion versions) and Incinerate Bones -> Conglaciation of Bone (no-illusion versions). Within a level the twins are damage-identical; the choice is whether you want the target wearing a skeleton illusion. Resist type also changes (fire at 42, cold at 55), so both tiers stay useful against resistant mobs.

stacking.notes: Instant nukes. The applied skeleton illusion on the target is a debuff-side illusion and is why the no-illusion twins exist.

stacking.notes: P99 tabulates all six fears in one table; they are split here only by target restriction.

members.name: Hungry Earth
members.note: Undead-only root (8 ticks) with a 26-75 damage component. Research spell. P99 lists it in both the nuke and root tables.

members.name: Root
members.note: 2-8 ticks, 30 mana, breaks randomly and on direct damage.

members.name: Paralyzing Earth
members.note: 30 ticks, 100 mana - the root-rot workhorse. Breaks on direct damage but not randomly. P99 level 49.

members.name: Instill
members.note: Legends DB row carries no effects; this is 'Enstill' on P99/Allakhazam - 12-16 tick root, 60 mana, breaks randomly and on DD. NAME DISCREPANCY: Legends 'Instill' vs classic 'Enstill'.

members.name: Immobilize
members.note: 10 ticks, 80 mana, breaks on DD but not randomly. Shorter than Paralyzing Earth - a fast-cast (1.75 s) root, not an upgrade.

replacement.note: Not a replacement chain at all above Root. Paralyzing Earth (30 ticks) remains the longest root the class ever gets; Enstill/Instill and Immobilize are shorter and exist for cast speed and mana. Necros carry two or three roots simultaneously and pick by needed duration.

conflicts.detail: Only one root effect can hold a mob; recasting refreshes/replaces. Root and snare are different effects and DO coexist.

stacksWith.detail: Snare and root are separate effects and can both be on a mob.

stacking.notes: Root-rot rotation depends on DoT choice: the DD-carrying DoTs (Poison Bolt/Venom/Envenomed Bolt, Disease Cloud line, Ignite Bones) can break root; the Muscle line and Chilling Embrace cannot.

lines.name: Shadow Vortex (AC drain + self AC recourse)

members.name: Minor Shielding
members.note: +10 HP, +4 AC (max-level values per P99).

members.name: Shielding

members.note: +11 to +13 AC, single friendly or self, 36 min. Cleric 19 / Necromancer 16 / Paladin 30; also on Proc: Shieldstorm.

replacement.note: Single member - the necromancer never gets a higher AC-slot-4 buff. It is the necro's only castable-on-others armor buff.

conflicts.detail: Holy Armor, Guard, Armor of Faith, Shield of Words, Aegis, Bulwark of Faith - all AC Slot 4, none stack with Spirit Armor. Aegolism (Slot 1 & 4) also blocks it.
Haze / Mist / Cloud / Obscure / Shade / Shadow / Umbra.
Scale Skin / Turtle Skin / Protect / Shifting Shield / Guardian / Shroud of the Spirits.
Phantom Leather / Chain / Plate / Armor.

stacksWith.detail: A necro can run Shield of the Magi and Spirit Armor together.
Cleric Resolution/Heroism, Druid Skin Like Nature etc.
Shadow Vortex Recourse.
Call of Earth, Augment, Celestial Tranquility, Song of the Deep Seas, bard rhythms.

stacking.notes: Confirms the prior wave's anchor: necro Spirit Armor is AC Slot 4, shared with the cleric Aegis family. In practice a grouped necro's Spirit Armor is overwritten by any cleric/enchanter/shaman armor buff worth having.

members.name: Banshee Aura
members.note: +9 to +12 damage shield, permanent duration, research/Kunark vendor. P99 level 16, SK 54.

replacement.note: Single member; the necro never gets a second damage shield.

conflicts.detail: Shield of Fire -> Cadeau of Flame / Aegis of Ro all sit in DS Slot 1; a mage damage shield overwrites Banshee Aura.
Shield of Thistles -> Legacy of Thorn line.
Feedback, O'Keil's Radiation.

stacksWith.detail: Kilva's Skin of Flame, Illusion: Fire Elemental, Frostreaver's Blessing.
Druid coats.
Thorny Shield.
Bard Psalm of Warmth / Cooling and McVaxius' Rousing Rondo.

members.name: Grim Aura
members.note: +5 to +10 ATK, permanent, self only. P99 level 4; SK 22; also on several clickies (Hand of Shadow, Reaper's Ring, Shrunken Goblin Skull Earring, Sword of Pain).

replacement.note: Single member. Mostly relevant because the clicky versions are handed to melee.

conflicts.detail: Firefist (+10) shares Attack Slot 1 with Grim Aura.
Strength of Nature (+25), Yaulp IV (+16), Celestial Tranquility (+40) are all Attack Slot 1 and overwrite Grim Aura.

stacksWith.detail: Call of the Predator, Illusion: Werewolf.
Avatar, wolf forms, Aura of Battle.
Visions of Grandeur, Frostreaver's Blessing, Shroud of Hate Recourse, Dance of the Blade.
Seething Fury, Rage of Tallon, McVaxius' Rousing Rondo.

members.name: Dead Man Floating
members.note: Single target. Water Breathing(2) + See Invisible(1) + Levitate(2) + 64-70 poison resist. Research spell. P99 level 44.

members.name: Dead Men Floating
members.note: Group version, 69-75 poison resist. Classic-2.0 NPC drop. P99 level 49.

replacement.note: Group version supersedes the single-target one outright (same components, slightly higher poison resist).

conflicts.detail: The two members share the slot with each other and with nothing else in the game - DMF has its OWN poison-resist heading on P99 Buff_Lines.

stacksWith.detail: Talisman of Shadoo, Resist Poison, Endure Poison, Resistant Skin all stack with DMF's +70.
Aura of Green Petals, bard Psalm of Purity, Aura of Purity potions all stack. DMF is a full +70 on top of everything - it is a component of the game's maximum poison resist (+361).

stacking.notes: PRIORITY - COMPONENT BREAKDOWN: (1) Poison resist - own slot, stacks with all other poison-resist lines, the single largest reason to cast it. (2) Levitate(2) - functionally the same as any levitation; overlaps with druid/shaman/wizard Levitate and with items. (3) See Invisible(1) - overlaps with Deadeye's see-invis and with See Invisible from other sources. (4) Water Breathing(2) - makes the necro's own Breath of the Dead redundant. P99's Buff_Lines page only tracks stat effects, so it lists DMF under Poison Resistance ONLY; the levitate / see-invis / water-breathing components are not slot-tabled anywhere authoritative and their interaction with other levitate/see-invis buffs is an open question.

members.name: Endure Cold
members.note: +11 to +20 CR. P99 level 4.

replacement.note: Resist Cold strictly supersedes Endure Cold.

conflicts.detail: Circle of Summer (+45), Resist Cold (+40), Endure Cold (+20) are one line - the biggest wins.

stacksWith.detail: Aura of White Petals, Elemental Armor.
Psalm of Warmth.
Aura of Heat potions.

stacking.notes: P99's Buff_Lines Cold Resistance section omits Necromancer from the class list for Endure/Resist Cold, but the P99 Necromancer spell list does grant them (levels 4 and 24). Treat the omission as a wiki gap, not a class difference.

members.name: Endure Disease
members.note: +18 to +20 DR. P99 level 12.

members.name: Resist Disease
members.note: +40 DR. P99 level 34.

replacement.note: Strict upgrade.

conflicts.detail: Talisman of Jasinth (+45) shares the line and beats Resist Disease (+40).
Aura of Black Petals (+50) is also in this line.

stacksWith.detail: Bard Psalm of Vitality.
Aura of Antibody potions, Aloe Sweat.

members.name: Gather Shadows
members.note: Self-only invisibility, 20 min. P99 level 8.

members.name: Skin of the Shadow
members.note: Invisibility + ultravision + 115% magnification (extended sight range). Overthere quest. ONLY works at night.

replacement.note: Skin of the Shadow is night-only, so Gather Shadows is never retired. Skin of the Shadow also folds in the Shadow Sight ultravision effect.

conflicts.detail: Invisibility effects overwrite each other; only one invis is up at a time. Casting or being cast on with another invis replaces it.

stacksWith.detail: Living-invis and undead-invis are separate effects and can both be up (the classic double-invis pull setup).

stacking.notes: Invisibility is not a stat buff, so P99 Buff_Lines does not tabulate it; treatment here is from standard classic behaviour.

members.name: Invisibility versus Undead
members.note: Single friendly or self, 27 min.

members.name: Invisibility Versus Undead
members.note: DUPLICATE DB ROW (different capitalisation, 'Invisibility(1)' effect text, targetType Single). Same spell - a data-hygiene issue on Legends, not a second line member.

members.name: Improved Invis vs Undead
members.note: 10 min, self. Velious NPC drop; P99 calls it 'Improved Invis to Undead'.

members.name: Improved Invisibility to Undead
members.note: DUPLICATE DB ROW of the level-50 spell under the long name. Same spell.

replacement.note: The level-50 version is 'improved' (harder to break / better undead evasion) but has a SHORTER duration (10 min vs 27 min) and is self-only, so the level-1 version stays in the book for buffing others and for long pulls.

conflicts.detail: One IVU effect at a time; recasting refreshes.

stacksWith.detail: IVU and normal invis coexist.

stacking.notes: Legends carries FOUR rows for what are really two spells. Recommend collapsing the duplicate pairs in the DB.

members.name: Deadeye
members.note: See Invisible + Infravision, permanent. P99 level 8.

members.name: Shadow Sight
members.note: Ultravision, permanent. P99 level 24.

replacement.note: NOT a replacement pair. Deadeye grants see-invisible (which Shadow Sight lacks); Shadow Sight upgrades infravision to ultravision. Both are commonly kept up, and Skin of the Shadow (55) supplies the ultravision half.

conflicts.detail: Infravision and ultravision are the same underlying night-vision effect; ultravision wins. See-invisible is separate.

stacksWith.detail: DMF also grants See Invisible(1) - redundant with Deadeye rather than additive.

stacking.notes: Not stat buffs, so untabulated on P99 Buff_Lines.

members.name: Harmshield
members.note: 3 ticks of total damage immunity, costs 20 HP on cast. Research spell. Cannot attack or cast while up.

members.name: Quivering Veil of Xarn
members.note: Same 3-tick invulnerability but HEALS 150 on cast instead of costing 20 HP, and is cheaper per second of safety. Kunark NPC drop.

replacement.note: Quivering Veil is strictly better (heal instead of cost) at the same duration. Harmshield is kept only until 58.

conflicts.detail: Only one invulnerability effect at a time; nothing else stacks meaningfully during it.

stacking.notes: The classic necro survival trick: Harmshield/QVoX to survive a Lich drain spike or a train, since damage-over-time and melee are both nullified.

members.name: Dark Empathy
members.note: Caster loses 30 HP, target gains 30. P99 level 8.

members.name: Corporeal Empathy
members.note: 215 for 215. Velious NPC drop. P99 level 44.

replacement.note: Straight magnitude upgrade of the same 1:1 HP transfer.

stacking.notes: Instant heals - no buff slot.

lines.name: Self-cost heal over time (Shadow Compact / Pact / Bond)

members.name: Shadow Compact
members.note: Target healed 20/tick for 4 ticks at the caster's HP cost. 10 mana. P99 level 20.

members.name: Pact of Shadow
members.note: 80/tick for 4 ticks (P99: caster loses 45/tick, target gains 81/tick - a net HP profit). 10 mana.

members.name: Shadowbond
members.note: 125/tick for 4 ticks. 10 mana. Quest spell (Vaean the Night).

replacement.note: Ascending throughput, identical shape and 10-mana cost throughout. The necro's mana-free group heal - HP is the resource, refilled with lifetaps.

conflicts.detail: Same line - recasting refreshes; a lower rank will not land over a higher one on the same target.

stacksWith.detail: These are heal-over-time spells, not regen buffs, and are additive with Regeneration/Chloroplast etc.

stacking.notes: The 'necro as backup healer' loop: Shadowbond the tank at 10 mana, then lifetap yourself back up. Interacts with the Lich drain - both are HP outflow at the same time.

members.name: Mend Bones
members.note: 33-50 to pet, plus 10 disease/poison/curse counters. P99 level 8.

members.name: Renew Bones
members.note: 154-175 to pet, plus counters. Research spell. P99 level 29.

replacement.note: Straight magnitude upgrade; identical cure rider.

stacking.notes: Instant heals - no slot interaction.

members.name: Cure Disease
members.note: Removes 4 disease counters. P99 level 16.

members.name: Counteract Disease
members.note: Removes 8 disease counters. P99 level 39.

replacement.note: Counter-strength upgrade.

members.name: Rapacious Subvention
members.note: Gives target 60 mana at a cost of 200 to the caster. P99 level 24. Legends carries this row twice (21 and 24).

members.name: Rapacious Subvention
members.note: DUPLICATE DB ROW at the P99 level. Same spell.

members.name: Covetous Subversion
members.note: 100 mana for 300. P99 level 44.

members.name: Sedulous Subversion
members.note: 150 mana for 400. Kunark NPC drop.

replacement.note: Efficiency improves at each tier (30% -> 33% -> 37.5% transfer). Lower ranks are retired once the higher is available.

stacking.notes: Instant mana transfer - no buff slot. P99's Buff_Lines page explicitly excludes 'twitch' spells from its tables.

members.name: Cavorting Bones
members.note: Pet level 1-2, warrior.

members.name: Leering Corpse
members.note: Pet 3-5.

members.name: Bone Walk

members.name: Convoke Shadow
members.note: Pet 7-11; magic-hits 11+.

members.name: Animate Dead
members.note: Pet 15-19; double attack, dual wield at 19+.

members.name: Haunting Corpse
members.note: Pet 18-22. Research spell.

members.name: Invoke Shadow
members.note: Pet 25-29. P99 level 34.

members.name: Malignant Dead
members.note: Pet 29-33; dual wield 33+, fast regen.

members.name: Cackling Bones
members.note: Pet 33-37; gains a lifetap proc (11).

members.name: Invoke Death
members.note: Pet 37-41; 42 lifetap. The classic top warrior pet. P99 level 49.

members.name: Minion of Shadows
members.note: Skeleton ROGUE, pet 39-43; backstab 147-171, no bash/kick. Quest spell - a sidegrade, not an upgrade.

members.name: Servant of Bones
members.note: Skeleton MONK, pet 40-44; flying kick, no bash. Sidegrade.

members.name: Emissary of Thule
members.note: SPECTRE warrior, pet 43-47, ~2700 HP, immune to fear. Terminal member.

replacement.note: Strict pet-level ascent through Invoke Death (48). Above that the line branches by pet CLASS: Minion of Shadows (rogue/backstab, best burst on a rooted mob), Servant of Bones (monk/flying kick), Emissary of Thule (spectre warrior, most HP, fear-immune). All three plus Invoke Death stay memorised situationally. Only the Emissary is fear-immune, which matters for fear-kiting groups. The Encyclopedia Necrotheurgia focus adds +1 pet level for spells 46-60.

conflicts.detail: One summoned pet at a time - casting a new pet spell requires dismissing/Reclaiming the old one (the new summon simply fails or the old is lost).

stacking.notes: Bone Chips are the reagent for every rank; the level 49+ pets also consume a Peridot.

members.name: Focus Death
members.note: +15% attack speed, +20 STR, +2 AC. Real live spell (Allakhazam 2541, Luclin-era Echo Caverns vendor). Absent from P99 - the lowest tier the classic set does not have.

members.name: Intensify Death
members.note: +22% to +30% attack speed, +26 to +33 STR, +6 to +8 AC. Research spell. P99 level 24.

members.name: Augment Death
members.note: +49% to +55% attack speed, +39 to +45 STR, +10 to +12 AC. P99 level 39.

members.name: Augmentation of Death
members.note: +65% attack speed, +52 to +55 STR, +14 to +15 AC. Velious NPC drop. Note: 17.5 min duration vs 60 min for the lower ranks.

replacement.note: Every stat ascends, but Augmentation of Death's duration drops from 60 minutes to ~17.5, so the 60-minute Augment Death is still worth casting when you will not be refreshing. Otherwise a clean chain.

conflicts.detail: A pet buffed with an enchanter/shaman haste (Alacrity, Celerity, Quickness, Swift Like The Wind) and the Death line share the primary haste slot - the stronger wins. Enchanter haste generally beats the necro's own on a pet.

stacksWith.detail: Bard Composition/Melody of Ervaj is a second haste slot and stacks.

stacking.notes: The STR and AC riders travel with the haste spell, so they are gained or lost together when a stronger haste overwrites.

members.name: Form of Chilled Bone
members.note: Illusion (race #802) on the pet, 120 min.

members.name: Form of Bleached Bone
members.note: Same effect shape, higher tier. Real live spell (Allakhazam 9988). Neither member exists on P99.

members.note: Bind Sight through the pet, 27 min. P99 level 12.

members.name: Voice Graft

members.name: Locate Corpse

members.name: Track Corpse
members.note: Kunark. Re-points every tick for 12 minutes - a tracking version of Locate Corpse.

members.name: Cancel Magic

members.name: Nullify Magic
members.note: Cancel Magic(4) x2. P99 level 39.

members.name: Annul Magic
members.note: Cancel Magic(9) x2.

members.name: Sacrifice
members.note: Kills a consenting player (levels 46-59) to create an Essence Emerald. Consumes an emerald. Quest spell.

members.name: Convergence
members.note: Resurrect a corpse at 93% experience. Consumes an Essence Emerald. NPC drop.

replacement.note: Not an upgrade chain - a producer/consumer pair. Sacrifice makes the reagent that Convergence (and Infusion, and Trucidation) consume.

members.name: Gate
members.note: Teleport to bind.

members.name: Shadow Step
members.note: Short random-direction blink. P99 level 8.

members.name: Levant
members.note: Self-only in-zone evacuation. Kunark NPC drop. Only works at night.

replacement.note: Three unrelated escape tools kept simultaneously - Gate leaves the zone, Levant relocates within it (night only), Shadow Step is a short blink. No replacement.

standalone.name: Coldlight
standalone.note: Summons a light source. No line.

standalone.name: Reclaim Energy
standalone.note: Destroys the pet for mana proportional to its remaining HP. Pet-management utility; no upgrade rank exists.

standalone.name: Impart Strength
standalone.note: Transfers 10 STR from caster to target for 6 minutes. Unique effect; never upgraded. Would sit in the Strength (Primary) buff line if it stacked at all - too small to matter.

standalone.name: Vampiric Embrace
standalone.note: Adds a lifetap proc to the caster's own melee (VampEmbraceNecro). Permanent self buff, no rank above it in the classic set. Shared with Shadow Knight.

standalone.name: Feign Death
standalone.note: The class-defining utility. No upgrade rank exists for necromancers (unlike monks' skill-based FD). Instant, 60 mana.

standalone.name: Tiny Companion
standalone.note: Shrinks the pet by 50%. Cosmetic/practical pet utility. Not on P99.

standalone.name: Breath of the Dead
standalone.note: Water breathing, permanent, self. No upgrade - and made redundant at 41 by Dead Man Floating's Water Breathing(2) component.

standalone.name: Screaming Terror
standalone.note: Single-target mesmerise (up to level 55) + 1% memory blur, 3 ticks. The necro's only mez. No upgrade rank. Feared/mezzed targets conflict: mez and fear cannot both hold a mob.

standalone.name: Eternities Torment
standalone.note: Undead-only DoT, 30/tick for 2 min 6 s. Real live spell (Allakhazam 2543, Luclin-era Echo Caverns vendor batch alongside Focus Death and Shackle of Bone). No P99 equivalent and no other rank - an unlined undead DoT. Whether it collides with the Disease or Darkness line is unverified.

standalone.name: Dark Soul
standalone.note: Curse-counter DoT, 96-140/tick for 30 s. Real live spell (Allakhazam 4096). No P99 equivalent, no sibling ranks. Curse counters mean only a Remove Curse cures it.

standalone.name: Summon Companion
standalone.note: Calls the pet to the caster. Velious. No line.

standalone.name: Bounce
standalone.note: 40% chance to reflect a spell, 12 s. Real live spell (Allakhazam 4099), researched (Pristine Supple Runic Hide + Quill of the Arch Lich). No P99 equivalent, no other rank.

standalone.name: Insidious Retrogression
standalone.note: 546-550 damage + 10% snare + -25 STR + -25 ATK over 1 min 36 s. Real live spell (Allakhazam 2545). Described as an aggro-kite opener. Not on P99; unlined.

standalone.name: Ward of Calliav
standalone.note: Pet damage rune (Legends lists 'Absorb Hit up to 11747 damage', a suspiciously large figure). Real live spell, MAG/NEC/BST 46-49. First member of the Calliav pet-rune line.

standalone.name: Infusion
standalone.note: Restores 1000 mana to self, 1 mana cost, consumes an Essence Emerald. Kunark NPC drop. Paired with Sacrifice as the emerald consumer; no upgrade rank.

openQuestions: Dead Man Floating's non-resist components (Levitate(2), See Invisible(1), Water Breathing(2)) are not slot-tabled on any authoritative classic source - P99's Buff_Lines only tracks stat effects and lists DMF solely under Poison Resistance. Whether DMF's levitate overwrites (or is overwritten by) druid/shaman/wizard Levitate, and whether its See Invisible collides with Deadeye, needs in-game testing on Legends.

Legends' Shackle of Spirit (L38) shows -10% melee haste while Shackle of Bone (L17) shows -20%. The higher-level spell should be the stronger slow; this looks like a data error in the Legends DB rather than a design choice.
Legends' Envenomed Bolt shows 351 damage per tick vs the classic 146 per tick (and 41 initial vs 110). Either Legends re-tuned the spell or the DB row is wrong.

The 'of Life' healing-reduction DoTs (Cancelling / Negation / Cessation of Life, levels 8/18/37) have no Allakhazam counterpart. Confirmed Legends-custom with high confidence, but their stacking behaviour against the classic DoT lines is untested.

Defoliate (L29) is a Druid spell name; Allakhazam's Necromancer list returns only Defoliation (52). Legends appears to have granted necros a lower plant nuke - confirm whether it is a Legends addition or a re-tier.

Eternities Torment (L27) and Dark Soul (L39) are real live spells with no sibling ranks and no P99 data - their DoT-line membership (and therefore what they will and will not stack with) is unresolved.

The Strength-debuff slot: Siphon Strength / Wave of Enfeeblement / Surge of Enfeeblement vs the Muscle DoT line's -STR component vs shaman Cripple/Weaken. P99's Buff_Lines page covers beneficial buffs only, so no authoritative slot table exists for detrimentals.

Legends carries four duplicate rows: Leach (L9 and L12), Rapacious Subvention (L21 and L24), Invisibility versus Undead / Invisibility Versus Undead (both L1), Improved Invis vs Undead / Improved Invisibility to Undead (both L50). These are almost certainly ingest duplicates, not re-tiers; recommend collapsing.
Legends' 'Instill' (L53) is the classic 'Enstill' and its DB row has no effects array at all - it needs the root effect populated.
P99's Buff_Lines Cold Resistance section omits Necromancer from Endure Cold / Resist Cold even though the P99 Necromancer spell list grants both. Treated here as a wiki gap.
